As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

sections.title: About The Role & Team
paras: Amplitude is the leading AI-first digital analytics platform that helped over 4,000 customers build better products and digital experiences. Our customer base includes Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, Square, and Under Armour. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2's Fall 2025 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.
The Customer Success team is responsible for building relationships with and driving long-term value realization for Amplitude's customers.

The Senior Technical Success Manager, Emerging Enterprise owns customer deployment, adoption, and value realization across Amplitude's digital analytics platform. They bring strong product knowledge and fluency in customer technical ecosystems: data foundations, taxonomy, instrumentation patterns, and AI agent configuration. They are execution-first and outcome-driven from presales through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

sections.title: As a Senior Technical Success Manager, Strategic, you will:
bullets: Own customer deployment, adoption, and outcomes for a portfolio of 40-50 accounts, from presales through renewal

Lead deployment planning and implementation across your book, e.g.: scoping, deployment plan creation, kickoff meetings, use case alignment, coordination of delivery (e.g. managing internal and partner teams), project reporting
Track and manage risks and issues across active deployments, driving resolution before they impact timelines or outcomes
Monitor portfolio health through AI-augmented signals, engaging proactively to accelerate adoption, drive renewals, and deepen stakeholder engagement

Drive product adoption by running live working sessions, identifying new use cases to expand value over time, and showcasing new platform capabilities with a point of view on how they enable customer growth
Develop and maintain success plans tied to customer goals, tracking milestones and risks from onboarding through renewal
Build and deliver executive business reviews that connect Amplitude usage to measurable business impact, turning adoption into a renewal and expansion story
Partner with Account Executives on renewals and expansion, building the value story, coaching champions, and identifying growth opportunities across your book

sections.title: Critical Skills Profile
bullets: Business Acumen: Understands each customer's business model, growth levers, and priorities. Builds a path to value that connects Amplitude's platform to the outcomes that matter most to the customer.

Technical Fluency: Comfortable with Amplitude data architecture, instrumentation methods, taxonomy design, and AI agent workflows. Able to unlock use cases and guide internal and partner delivery teams.

Delivery Excellence: Drives deployment and implementation quality across a full book of business. Manages timelines, coordinates internal and partner delivery teams, and ensures every account progresses through milestones on time and to standard.

Prescriptive Customer Guidance: Sets the standard for what good looks like at each stage of the customer journey. Drives accountability across deployment and ongoing success. Pushes back on bad implementation patterns, guides customers toward proven approaches, and holds them accountable to their own defined success criteria.
Diagnostic Thinking: Proactively recognizes adoption gaps and technical blockers early and drives creative solutions that get customers back on track.

Curiosity and Self-Sufficiency: Defaults to figuring things out independently. Explores edge cases on your own, and comes to conversations with a point of view. This role requires someone who runs toward ambiguity.
AI Innovation: Embeds AI in day-to-day workflow to improve efficiency and customer outcomes. Experiments, iterates, and shares best practices.

sections.title: At a minimum, you need to have:
bullets: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS
3+ years of experience specifically leading enterprise software deployments where change management and foundational data governance were core priorities.
2+ years managing a portfolio of 8-10 Strategic accounts
Experience co-owning renewals and contributing to expansion pipeline alongside a sales counterpart
Experience training or enabling non-technical teams to become data-sufficient.
Excellent communication skills to influence everyone from a data engineer to a C-level executive.
Expert-level project management skills and the ability to thrive in an independent and fast-paced environment.

sections.title: About Gusto
paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: As a Technical Account Manager, you will act as the single point of contact for all support inquiries, enhancing their user experience and serving as a subject matter expert for Gusto’s core products. You will guide customers through our newest product features, provide proactive customer education and support, partner cross-functionally, move quickly to strategize and creatively solve problems, act as their advocate internally to influence our product decisions and roadmap, and holistically support the customer/Gusto partnership. You’ll address and solve real problems and deliver an exceptional customer experience to some of our most valued companies to build trust and loyalty to Gusto for the book of business.

This role requires leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate research and communication by demonstrating fluency in delegating repetitive work, crafting structured prompts, and critically reviewing outputs for accuracy, tone, and empathy, all while consistently applying compliance and data-privacy guardrails, delivering measurable efficiency gains, and exercising sound judgment on when to avoid AI or escalate edge cases.

sections.title: About the Team:
paras: The Dedicated Service team is a segment of our Care team dedicated to building and expanding relationships with our high-value customers. The team manages an assigned book of customer accounts, serving as product experts, and providing trusted and efficient service.

sections.title: Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
bullets: Own the customer journey by building trust, rapport, and partnership with your book of business through inbound and outbound phone, email, and Google Meet interactions.
Act as a dedicated advisor, building trust in the support you provide to contain most customer interactions from your dedicated customers.
Provide passionate, opinionated, consistent, expert, reliable support as a dedicated point of contact for payroll and benefits inquiries .
Proactively connect with customers to build a deep understanding of their business, your support model, and their preferred connection style.
Identify churn risk and quickly act to deliver solutions to mitigate the risk of churn, using your product knowledge and unique understanding of each individual customer.
Partner with your customers and cross-functionally to unblock points of friction, proactively address potential concerns, and build an understanding of individual team needs and processes.

Think creatively, pivot quickly, live in ambiguity, and collaborate strategically. You will be required to expand your critical thinking skills and creatively problem-solve across all areas of the business, with an understanding of a variety of stakeholders and needs.
Display strong product knowledge, including a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to protect against customer churn.

jobs.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The Enterprise CSM, Bill Pay & Procurement Specialist, ensures Ramp’s upmarket customers quickly unlock value from our AP Automation and Procurement products. As part of the Customer Activation team, you’ll guide customers through implementation, configure workflows aligned to their internal processes, and help them operationalize Ramp’s tools to drive efficiency and compliance. In this role, you will help shape Ramp’s Enterprise activation motion for Bill Pay & Procurement and influence the strategy that accelerates customer adoption and business impact.

sections.title: Deliver High-Quality Implementations
bullets: Lead Enterprise customers through the end-to-end onboarding of Ramp Bill Pay and Procurement, ensuring fast, accurate, and complete deployment
Educate customers on Ramp’s AP workflows, procurement best practices, approval logic, vendor management, and policy configuration

sections.title: Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes
bullets: Prevent delays in implementation by proactively identifying blockers and reinforcing the value of adopting Ramp’s AP & Procurement solutions
Understand customers’ current AP, purchasing, and approval processes to identify pain points, recommend improvements, and guide them toward an optimized rollout

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.
You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
You're fast-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed-of-service metrics.

jobs.title: Global Aid Account Manager
jobs.blurb: The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people.…
jobs.summary:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: Flexport.org is the humanitarian arm of Flexport. We serve nonprofits, NGOs, and mission-driven organizations that need to move impactful cargo reliably, often into some of the hardest environments to reach. As humanitarian and development needs keep climbing, the supply chain expertise our partners can count on matters more than ever.

You'll own some of Flexport.org's most complex and highest-impact partner relationships. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes: ocean, air, trucking, and customs, and demand real supply chain fluency to navigate well. You won't just manage these relationships, you'll shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every partner engagement, lead business reviews that drive real decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to help partners do more with what they have. You'll operate with full autonomy, hold a high bar on program growth and retention, and become someone junior teammates turn to for guidance.

sections.title: You Will
bullets: Own end-to-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi-modal Flexport.org partner accounts, including partners with significant program growth potential and high operational intensity.
Lead RFP bids and contract renewals end-to-end.

Serve as a true strategic partner to nonprofits, NGOs, and mission-driven organizations, going deep on their supply chain operations to find where Flexport can cut cost, add capability, or move faster.
Lead high-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting. Bring market context, multi-modal insight, and recommendations tailored to each partner's mission and constraints.
Drive expansion across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding program growth and retention targets.
Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Legal, Trade Lane Management, and other Flexport.org teams on solutions that need internal alignment and creative problem-solving.
Mentor account teammates: share playbooks, join key partner calls, and help the team raise its game.
Use AI-enabled tools to automate and improve internal and partner-facing processes where it makes the work faster or better.

sections.title: You Should Have
bullets: 5+ years in account management, business development, or a similar partner-facing role. A background in logistics, supply chain, humanitarian aid, or international development is strongly preferred.
A track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi-product book of business.
Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes. You can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
Comfort operating without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations, and the judgment to write the playbook for others once you've solved it.
Strong commercial instincts: you spot growth opportunities before partners ask, and you close them.
Genuine curiosity about the humanitarian and development space. You want to become an expert in aid logistics, not just move freight.
A natural tendency to develop others. Peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
A compliance-first mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and our partners and regulators need to trust us.

sections.title: You Will Get
bullets: Ownership of Flexport.org's most complex and meaningful partner relationships, the accounts where the impact is biggest.
A visible role in shaping how the Flexport.org account team operates. Your judgment and approach set the standard.
Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
A front-row seat on Flexport.org's mission: getting aid to the people who need it, on time.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp wins when our customers win. Ramp’s customer base is scaling rapidly, spanning more businesses, more users, and more use cases across increasingly complex finance operations. At the same time, our expanding product surface area — from cards and expense management to bill payments, procurement, vendor management, accounting automation, and emerging products — is creating more nuanced customer needs and more cross-functional support moments. AI is changing what is possible in parallel: giving CX new ways to route, resolve, and guide customers, while raising the bar for where human judgment, specialization, and consultative support matter most.

We are hiring a Director to lead a critical part of our omni-channel Customer Experience organization: the teams and leaders serving customers across Phone, Email, and Chat. You will lead within a 24/7 customer operation, ensuring the right coverage, leadership, and customer experience across channels. This role is accountable for the performance of its channel portfolio, helping customers get the right answer quickly and delivering consistent results across quality, speed, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

The role combines direct leadership of channel teams with close partnership across CX Operations, CX Specialized teams, CX AI Ops, and Product Operations. You will develop strong managers and frontline teams, create real accountability, and stay close enough to the work to understand where customers and teams are getting stuck. You will translate the department’s direction into clear priorities, stronger operating routines, and measurable improvements across Phone, Email, and Chat.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own day-to-day channel execution — lead Phone, Email, and Chat teams, stay close to the work, and drive frontline performance across customer satisfaction, quality, service levels, resolution quality, and productivity.
Develop CX leadership — coach Managers, set clear expectations, and build accountability for team performance and customer outcomes.
Serve as an escalation point — help resolve high-priority customer and internal escalations, bringing sound judgment, urgency, and clear communication to complex issues.

Challenge how we operate — evaluate whether our metrics, workflows, team structures, training, and operating model meet today’s customer and business needs. Bring a founder mindset by questioning assumptions, testing new approaches, and helping the organization evolve.

Shape the AI-powered future of CX — define how CX should evolve as Ramp grows, including how managers lead, how frontline teams use AI and automation, where specialization improves the customer experience, and where human judgment should be elevated.

Turn strategy and emerging opportunities into scalable operations — translate department priorities and new business areas into clear channel plans, repeatable processes, strong change management, and high adoption across Phone, Email, and Chat.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: Experience as a leader who has managed large, complex operational teams in a fast-paced environment; traditional support experience is valuable but not required.

Exceptional learning agility and horsepower, with startup or similarly high-ownership operating experience; you learn new domains quickly, move through ambiguity, and build structure without waiting for perfect information.
A record of improving customer-facing operations through rigorous analysis, strategic problem solving, and strong execution, including finding practical solutions to complex problems others may miss.
An empathetic, direct leadership style that develops people while holding a high personal and team bar for performance, quality, ownership, and follow-through.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to align teams and cross-functional partners around difficult decisions.
A builder mentality around technology and operations, with experience using AI, automation, or workflow tooling to transform the customer and team experience and drive changes from idea to adoption.
Curiosity about the business behind the support motion, with the ability to connect customer needs, product complexity, frontline workflows, and company priorities.

sections.title: About Vanta
paras: We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. sections.title: An overview of this role
paras: As a Renewal Manager, you'll own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for a defined portfolio of GitLab customers, protecting and growing recurring revenue while ensuring a smooth, transparent experience at every contract touchpoint. You'll engage customers well ahead of renewal, lead pricing and commercial discussions, negotiate complex agreements, and proactively address risk so customers can continue to rely on GitLab's DevSecOps platform without disruption. You'll also play a key role in guiding customers through the transition from seat-based licensing to GitLab's consumption-based Flex pricing model, helping them understand usage patterns, model scenarios, and land on a structure that aligns with how their teams actually work. In this quota-carrying role within the Renewals team, you'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product to forecast outcomes, reduce churn, and uncover expansion opportunities — and you'll leverage AI-powered tooling to analyze account health, surface renewal risk earlier, and move faster on the commercial activities that matter most. In your first year, you'll be focused on building strong relationships with key stakeholders in your accounts, consistently delivering on-time renewals, and contributing to scalable renewal processes that support GitLab's long-term growth.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for an assigned portfolio of customer contracts, from early engagement through signed agreement.
Develop and execute account-level renewal strategies that protect recurring revenue and reduce customer churn.
Prepare renewal proposals, pricing quotes, and contract documentation in line with customer needs and internal guidelines.
Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with customer stakeholders, managing pricing discussions, terms, and timelines.
Identify and qualify opportunities to expand footprint through upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.
Monitor customer health, usage, and satisfaction signals to surface at-risk renewals early and drive mitigation plans.
Maintain accurate renewal pipeline, forecasts, and activity tracking in CRM and related systems to enable clear reporting and planning.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to remove obstacles, align on strategy, and ensure timely, smooth renewals.

sections.title: What You’ll Bring
bullets: Experience owning an end-to-end renewal motion for subscription or SaaS contracts, including forecasting, negotiation, and closing.
Background in B2B subscription-based businesses with a track record of meeting or exceeding renewal and retention goals.
Skill in managing a portfolio of renewal accounts at scale while prioritizing high-impact opportunities and risks.
Proficiency working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis and reporting.
Ability to build productive relationships with customer stakeholders, navigate complex procurement processes, and lead commercial discussions.
Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to structure renewals, address adoption gaps, and manage contract terms.
Strength in identifying renewal risks early, using customer health and usage data, and developing practical mitigation plans.
Openness to learning GitLab's platform and processes, with transferable skills welcomed from renewals, account management, sales, or customer success roles.

sections.title: About the team
paras: The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

paras: Eversight, part of Instacart, is building next-generation data insights and analytics platforms that help leading CPGs & Retailers make smarter, faster decisions across pricing, promotions, retail media, and omni-commerce. Process documentation and standardized frameworks built as you go, not bolted on after the fact

paras: AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the Leader of Account Management, you'll manage a team of 12+ Account Managers who own the full customer lifecycle post-sale, from value based selling through to activation and adoption. The measure of success in this role is Net Dollar Retention: durable expansion revenue, value realization and retention. This is a people-leadership role first — you'll coach your team toward AI-native ways of working, not just AI-aware, and hold a genuinely high performance bar for a team built to own outcomes end to end.

paras: The Account Management team helps small businesses get real value out of Gusto's products. Each team understands their entire book of business and anticipates their needs, identifies growth opportunities as they occur, builds and develops pipeline and positions the right solution for each customer. From there they drive activation and adoption leading to customer value realization and retention. You'll join a peer group of experienced leaders and should expect your team's size and scope to grow over time as we continue investing in this team.

Operational Excellence & Strategic Execution

Run a weekly cadence of forecast calls, pipeline review, and activity coaching (dials, connects, and other lead indicators) that ties directly to revenue outcomes.
Drive goal setting, sales strategy, and hands-on coaching to exceed expansion and retention targets.
Set and drive team-level AI adoption goals; model AI-fluent workflows for your team.
Build and manage a proactive outbound motion that drives expansion revenue across your team's book.
Ensure your team stays engaged post-sale, driving product activation, adoption, and utilization to convert expansion into durable retention.
Optimize sales processes and KPIs across the full funnel, from expansion to retention.
Leverage customer and usage data to refine segmentation, targeting, and account strategy.
